whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Dine & Disc,

I noticed your restaurant has strong 4.4★ reviews with over 400 reviews on Boring Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and menu browsing.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, digital menu showcase, aur customer reviews integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/dinedisc

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Dine & Disc team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Dine & Disc) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? [If checked]: Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, digital menu showcase, and your strong 4.4★ review highlights on Boring Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? [If not checked]: No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai. Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
